static_tensor_observation.reader_source:
import sys,json,struct,os,hashlib,math
sys.path.insert(0,'src')
from heterollm_sim.gguf_parity import _read_string,_read_value,_TENSOR_TYPES
out=[]
for ref in json.loads(sys.argv[1]):
 p=ref['path']
 with open(p,'rb') as f:
  initial=os.fstat(f.fileno());head=f.read(24)
  assert len(head)==24 and head[:4]==b'GGUF'
  version,nt,nk=struct.unpack('<IQQ',head[4:]);assert version in (2,3)
  values={}
  for _ in range(nk):
   key=_read_string(f);value=_read_value(f,struct.unpack('<I',f.read(4))[0])
   if key=='general.architecture' or key.endswith('.embedding_length'):values[key]=value
  matches=[]
  for _ in range(nt):
   name=_read_string(f);rank=struct.unpack('<I',f.read(4))[0];assert rank<=8
   dims=struct.unpack('<'+'Q'*rank,f.read(8*rank));typ=struct.unpack('<I',f.read(4))[0];offset=struct.unpack('<Q',f.read(8))[0]
   if name=='output_norm.weight':
    spec=_TENSOR_TYPES[typ];n=math.prod(dims);assert n%spec[1]==0
    matches.append({'name':name,'shape':list(dims),'type_id':typ,'dtype':spec[0],'physical_bytes':n//spec[1]*spec[2],'offset':offset})
  end=f.tell();f.seek(0);directory_sha=hashlib.sha256(f.read(end)).hexdigest();final=os.fstat(f.fileno())
  assert (initial.st_ino,initial.st_size,initial.st_mtime_ns)==(final.st_ino,final.st_size,final.st_mtime_ns)
  assert initial.st_size==ref.get('bytes',ref.get('size_bytes'))
  out.append({'model':ref['model'],'path':p,'frozen_expected_full_sha256':ref['sha256'],'full_identity_revalidated':False,'scope':'header_only_static_observation_no_tensor_payload_read','header_bytes':end,'header_sha256':directory_sha,'static_metadata':values,'output_norm':matches})
print(json.dumps(out))
